o.text: Possibly from Ottoman Turkish باشلانغیج (başlangıc). Related to Azerbaijani başlamaq (“to begin”). By surface analysis, başlan- + -ğıc.
From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (avurd). Cognate with Turkish avurt.
Borrowed from Arabic صُخُور (ṣuḵūr), plural of صَخْرَة (ṣaḵra).
